paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.34% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+1.02%) and Hang Seng weakest (-0.90%). Brent crude changed +1.90% to 110.86. Gold changed +0.06% to 4,145.0. Bitcoin changed +0.49% to 83,350.1172. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.117%, a relative move of -0.37%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-3.35%) and Jefferies (+3.23%) moved the most.
